info.title: PlaneMem context item history reads
info.description: Source-only description of two existing GET operations. Register the adjacent context-history schema under its full ID. Complete shared-parser structures and runtime-only cross-field checks are documented separately from legacy Gateway enforcement. This is not the complete WCP API, generated-client compatibility or runtime evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure the deployment origin and base path.

x-source-boundaries.description: These are shared parser/dedicated client limits, not uniform HTTP server response limits. The legacy handlers do not invoke the complete shared parser, have no dedicated two-slot guard, total request deadline or response-byte bound. SDK/Web/MCP limits and cancellation do not establish server SQL cancellation. Database statement/lock limits are separate. The handlers recheck neither session expiry after the transaction nor live source freshness.

x-http-input: GET bodies are not parsed and these routes do not explicitly reject body framing. Only history accepts single before_version/limit query fields; specified-version accepts none. Generic If-Match/If-Match-Version headers are parsed for valid, consistent versions but do not condition the read; Idempotency-Key does not make this GET a write or replay cache. No conditional 304, Range/206 or current-edit ETag is implemented. These are existing limitations, not claims that headers are strictly rejected.

get.summary: Read one page of recorded versions
get.description: Authorize context.read through Policy, then read current item visibility and historical metadata in one repeatable-read read-only transaction. The current item may be archived. Both current and historical restricted classifications require actual data.restricted.read; an administrator role alone does not bypass those SQL filters. No separate parent-project-row lookup is made by this history handler. Missing/invisible current item returns 404; an existing visible item with no visible recorded history returns an empty page. Order is descending numeric version, bounded by current_version and optional exclusive before_version, with limit+1 lookahead. Filtering and unrecorded legacy versions can cause gaps. Continuation is the last returned version when lookahead exists; otherwise it is omitted. Keep item_id and limit and pass next_before_version as before_version. No signed cursor, identity-bound continuation, cross-page snapshot, complete-history claim or hash verification of unreturned snapshot bodies.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional; defaults to 25, range 1..100. Exactly one canonical positive decimal value, no leading zero, sign, fraction or exponent.

parameters.name: before_version
parameters.description: Optional exclusive version bound. Exactly one canonical positive decimal of 1..16 digits and <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. A value of 1 is valid and can yield an empty page.

200.description: Complete history page with current_version/current_archived and recorded summaries. Baseline entries have null actor/client/event and do not invent historical commands. No outer revision, JSON etag, HTTP ETag or server_cursor. Outer source is exactly the requested context-item without revision.

get.summary: Read one explicitly recorded immutable version
get.description: Use the same context.read Policy and current/historical classification filters as history in one repeatable-read read-only transaction. The requested version must have a recorded row and cannot exceed the current version; missing or filtered history is 404, without falling back to current content. Gateway checks stored summary, item id/scope/version/title/classification/status, source references and canonical fingerprint({item,archived_at}). It does not execute every shared-parser constraint. Return original item content (possibly arbitrary legacy JSON), saved trace, archived timestamp and historical confirmation. Only confirm operations have confirmation metadata; Gateway emits null otherwise. SHA-256 sorts object keys recursively and preserves arrays; it checks snapshot self-consistency, not signatures, attribution authenticity or external sources. Historical confirmed/expired/excluded state is readable when visible and does not authorize current confirmation, restore, editing or source use. No current source freshness traversal.

200.description: Complete recorded revision. Outer source_refs are the requested context-item with pinned revision followed by the original item's sources in their saved order. Outer trace is this read; item.trace_id is the original saved trace. No outer revision, JSON etag, HTTP ETag or server_cursor. Schema cannot recompute SHA-256 or cross-field equality; dedicated clients do these checks before exposing the snapshot.

GatewayBearer.description: Verified issuer token with exact scope headers matching complete claims or configured fallback project. Policy context.read accepts the capability or its existing admin-role bypass, subject to Policy/OPA; workbench.read or the workbench client's Base can map to context.read. Restricted SQL rows still require actual data.restricted.read. These GET routes do not independently require an authenticated client claim; the scoped legacy client fallback remains possible. Token verification/Policy precede dispatch, without a handler-specific expiry recheck after reading. The decision observer runs before handler dispatch and is not a successful-read receipt.

ItemId.name: item_id
ItemId.description: Exact local item ID in the authorized project, not restricted to ULIDs. Percent-encode as one segment; decode once. Reject empty/blank, controls, lone surrogates, more than 255 UTF-16 code units, or the exact dot segments '.' and '..'.

Version.name: version
Version.description: One canonical positive decimal of 1..16 digits, <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. No leading zeros, sign, fraction, exponent or latest alias.

TenantId.name: x-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Exact authorized tenant. HTTP scope authentication checks nonempty equality, while snapshot/shared client parsing requires ULIDs; this parameter does not claim a stricter HTTP lexical validator.

WorkspaceId.name: x-workspace-id
WorkspaceId.description: Exact authorized workspace; same HTTP versus shared snapshot distinction as tenant.

ProjectId.name: x-project-id
ProjectId.description: Exact authorized project; scope is never taken from history JSON.

TraceParent.name: traceparent
TraceParent.description: Nonempty opaque value takes precedence over x-trace-id. This boundary does not parse W3C Trace Context or require both headers to agree. Supply a shared-parser-compatible identifier.

TraceId.name: x-trace-id
TraceId.description: Used if traceparent is absent/empty; if both are absent/empty, generates trace_http_<ULID>. Shared success parsers impose identifier limits beyond generic HTTP selection.

ExpectedActorId.name: x-expected-actor-id
ExpectedActorId.description: Independently optional exact precondition on verified actor identity, never an identity override.

ExpectedClientId.name: x-expected-client-id
ExpectedClientId.description: Independently optional exact precondition on context client identity, including legacy fallback where allowed. No paired-header requirement.

NoStore.description: Application JSON cache policy; pre-application parser/proxy errors may differ.

ErrorTrace.description: Command-boundary errors include this header; early authentication/input errors may omit it. Retain body.trace_id.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Application error shape with open details. Does not impose the dedicated clients' 16 KiB budget or authorize automatic retry.

Error.description: Application error; no partial page or substitute version. HTTP parser/proxy errors before the application may use another representation.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for malformed encoding/item ID/version, unsupported or duplicate query fields, noncanonical decimals or limit >100. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed or inconsistent generic version headers. retryable=false.

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED for missing/rejected Bearer token; retryable=false. Early errors do not guarantee WWW-Authenticate or x-trace-id.

Denied.description: DENIED for unauthorized scope/expected identity or Policy denial; retryable=false. Missing/invisible current items and filtered historical versions use 404.

NotFound.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_NOT_FOUND for missing/invisible current item, missing/filtered requested revision or version above current. retryable=false. Visible current item with no visible history is instead a successful empty directory.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED from general actor/path limiter; retryable=true. No dedicated history two-slot error or Retry-After promise.

InvalidStored.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_INVALID for handler-detected invalid stored metadata, confirmation, dates, version or snapshot binding/hash; retryable=false. The legacy handler does not enforce every shared schema constraint. Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR uses serializer default retryable=true.

Unavailable.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for missing database or non-ContractError transaction/read failure; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE and AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. retryable=true. No fallback in-memory history or synthesized baseline.
